hookKeys.title: Hook keys
hookKeys.intro: Each machine uses a key to send Claude Code events. Sessions that arrive with one of your keys are visible only to you. Use one key per machine, so you can revoke just one.
hookKeys.copyNow: Copy it now: it won't be shown again. It goes in CLAUDE_MONITOR_TOKEN on that machine.
hookKeys.autoInstallIntro: Download the script to the machine you want to connect and run it: it installs the hook and updates the global Claude Code settings, after saving a backup copy.
hookKeys.openPowerShell: Open PowerShell in the folder where you downloaded the file.
hookKeys.openTerminal: Open a terminal in the folder where you downloaded the file.
hookKeys.deleteScript: Delete the script: it contains the key in clear text.
hookKeys.openSession: Start a new Claude Code session: its card appears on the dashboard.
hookKeys.windowsNote: The script edits %USERPROFILE%\.claude\settings.json and leaves a settings.json.backup-date-time copy in the same folder.
hookKeys.unixNote: The script requires python3. It edits ~/.claude/settings.json and leaves a settings.json.backup-date-time copy in the same folder.
hookKeys.empty: No keys yet: create one to connect your first machine.
hookKeys.updateTitle: Update the hook on a connected machine
hookKeys.updateIntro: After a Claude Monitor update the hook script may change. To download it again, run this command on the machine: its key and settings stay as they are.
hookKeys.updateNote: It takes effect from the next event, including sessions that are already open.
hookKeys.focusIntro: Optional. This command starts a small agent on the Mac that stays connected to the dashboard: the cards of its sessions get a button that brings the Claude Code window to the front. The agent only receives the session identifier: it doesn't run commands or send keystrokes.
hookKeys.focusNote: Run it in a terminal on the Mac, after updating the hook. The same command updates the agent; to remove it: bash ~/.claude/hooks/claude-monitor-agent.sh uninstall.
hookKeys.copyKeyFailed: Copy failed: select the key and copy it manually.
hookKeys.copyCommandFailed: Copy failed: select the command and copy it manually.
hookKeys.downloadFailed: Installation script unavailable: use the key with the manual installation.
